articles.summary: As people age, maintaining strong social connections becomes more than just a luxury—it becomes a critical element of overall health and well-being. At Sonida Senior Living, we understand that community is more than a place to live; it’s a vibrant, supportive environment where relationships flourish and isolation fades.
